### Fixed

- *(meta)* The hook identity is policed by the chart and the storage-version backup no longer lists every Helm release Secret with its payload — every hook Job gets a network policy as a hook object (cilium + kubernetes flavours), the release scan goes through the server-side Table one Secret at a time ([#413](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/413), [#414](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/414)) in [#415](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/415) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
